answer_1.quote: we curate two datasets: HAICTrain (Human Action and Interaction Comprehension Training set) and HAICBench (a benchmark for evaluation). HAICTrain contains 126K videos accumulated from WebVid , annotated in our defined caption format by Gemini-1.5-Pro .
answer_1.outputs: video captions in a standardized format describing human attributes, actions, and interactions

answer_2.quote: For multiple-choice questions in MVBench, PerceptionTest, and HAICBench, we followed the prompting approach in LLaVA-1.5 and used accuracy as the metric. For ActivityNet-QA which features open-ended questions, we followed the evaluation protocol in Video-ChatGPT , utilizing GPT-4o-0513 to calculate accuracy.
